name: Bar with a live clock
description: A fixed solid band 64px tall in the page ground. The wordmark at the left margin (h4 step); in the centre three one-word links at 16px, 32px apart; at the right margin a live readout of two short lines at 16px in the text face with tabular figures (the client's local time and its city, set from the browser clock for the client's time zone and refreshing every 30 seconds) beside the one action as the dealt button, 40px tall. Only real facts the page has: never invented numbers or a status. Nothing else moves. Hover: a link takes the accent. On a phone: the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button at the right; the readout, the links and the action move into the full-screen sheet.
signature: A live local-time readout of two 16px lines (the client's time and city, refreshing every 30 seconds) sits beside the action in a 64px band, the one part of the page that visibly changes without a scroll.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu text button right; the readout, links and action in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with conditions: only real data the page has (the client's time zone and city), never invented numbers or fake dashboards; proportional text face, no mono, 16px minimum; the bar is solid so it never runs over content.

name: Top row with a bottom dial menu
description: A fixed layer, there from the first frame. Top: the wordmark centred at the h3 step and the one action as the dealt button at the right margin, each on a solid tab of the ground. The menu is a dial fixed at the bottom of the screen: a filled disc in the surface tone, 1100px across, centred with its centre 454px below the bottom edge so only a 96px arc shows (620px wide where it meets the edge). Five one- or two-word section names sit on the rim, 13 degrees apart, in mixed case at 16px, the current one at the top of the arc in the ink at weight 600 and the others in the muted ink, turned with the rim; the current one follows the section in view. A tap or an arrow key on a neighbour turns the names (320ms) and scrolls to that section. No rings, ticks or lines. The disc is opaque and the page keeps 120px free under its last line, so no text ends under the arc. On a phone: a 640px disc with three names shown, and the top row reduced to the wordmark and the action.
signature: Only a 96px arc of a large filled disc shows along the bottom edge, the five section names set on its rim 13 degrees apart with the current one at the top of the arc in weight 600; tapping a neighbour turns the rim and scrolls to that section.
phone: 640px disc with three names; top row wordmark and action.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the rotated tagline (a sentence in the navigation) is gone and the layer is there from the first frame, with no intro; the dial is one filled disc holding one- or two-word names, with no rings or tick marks, so it is a control surface and not a drawn illustration. Un-banned.

name: Bottom-docked groups
description: Docked at the bottom instead of the top. Two opaque groups 48px tall float 20px above the bottom edge and the page margin in from the sides, in the surface tone with ink letters and the dealt corner (the page ground showing round them): at the left one block that names the section in view (one or two words that change as scroll passes the sections); at the right a block of two one-word links followed by the one action as the dealt button. Both slide down out of view on scroll down (translateY 140%, 280ms) and come back on the first scroll up. At the top of the first screen only the wordmark stands, at the left margin, in flow, scrolling away with the hero. The page keeps 96px free under its last line. On a phone: one full-width opaque bar, 56px plus the safe area, at the page margin from the sides, holding Menu, the section name and the action.
signature: Two separate opaque groups float 20px above the bottom edge, a block naming the section in view at the left and two links plus the action at the right; both slide down on scroll down and return on the first scroll up, and only the wordmark stands at the top.
phone: One full-width opaque dock 56px plus the safe area: Menu, section name, the action.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the translucent glass pills are opaque surface-tone groups with the dealt corner; the idea, bottom-docked groups that hide on scroll down, stays. The left block shows a one- or two-word section name only. Un-banned.

name: Centre panel with loose ends
description: Three loose pieces at the top of the first screen. At the left margin the wordmark (h4 step). In the centre an opaque panel 60px tall in the surface tone, the dealt corner, holding three one-word links and the one action as the dealt button. At the right margin a one-word text link (Contact or Sign in). Over the hero the ends are bare letters on the page ground whose ink is chosen to read on the hero; once the hero has gone the ends fade out (200ms) and only the centre panel stays fixed, now with a 28px monogram at its left end, so nothing bare runs over content. Hover: link letters take the accent. On a phone: a single opaque 56px bar with the wordmark and Menu; the panel dissolves into the sheet.
signature: At the top of the first screen the wordmark and one text link stand loose at the two margins with a 60px surface-tone panel (three links and the action) centred between them; once the hero has gone only the panel stays, with a 28px monogram added at its left end.
phone: Single 56px opaque bar with wordmark and Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the blurred panel is opaque; the mono status line (a sentence in mono) and the swatch chip are gone; type is proportional; the loose ends fade after the hero. Un-banned.

name: Centred wordmark with right-hand controls
description: No bar: the wordmark (typeset, or the client's own mark) centred at the top, its centre 40px below the top edge, at the h3 step, on a small solid tab of the page ground. At the right margin a Menu text button and the one action as the dealt button. The left stays empty by design: the centred wordmark is the only anchor, so the pair of right-hand items must be at least 160px wide in all. Unchanged on scroll. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page). On a phone: wordmark centred, Menu at the right, the action at the foot of the sheet.
signature: A wordmark tab dead centre at the top with nothing at its left, while Menu and the action cluster at the right margin, unchanged at every scroll position.
phone: Wordmark centred, Menu at the right, the action in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The right side always carries Menu and the action so a real navigation exists; no sound or language toggle (the deal gives the page neither).

name: Centred wordmark-and-links cluster
description: One tight group centred on a 56px solid band of the page ground: a small wordmark (h4 step, in the ink) followed 40px later by two one-word links at 16px, 28px apart, and 28px after them the one action as the dealt button, 40px tall. The group is about 480px wide at 1440 and sits exactly on the centre line; the left and right slots stay empty, so the bar reads as a pause in the page. Fixed and identical at every scroll position; over a hero of the same ground the band is invisible. Hover: a link takes the accent. On a phone: the cluster shrinks to the wordmark and a Menu text button centred together, and a tap opens the full-screen sheet with the action at its foot.
signature: The whole bar is one group of about 480px (wordmark, two links, the action) sitting exactly on the centre line of a 56px band, with the left and right slots empty.
phone: Wordmark and Menu centred together; sheet carries the action.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The fill-less layer is a solid band so content never runs under letters; two links and the action only.

name: Compact panel, top right
description: A compact opaque panel fixed at the top right, aligned to the right page margin and 20px below the top edge, about 580px wide and 56px tall, filled with the surface tone with the dealt corner. The wordmark chip at the left (h4 step), three or four one-word links at 16px, and the one action as the dealt button, 40px tall, at the right end. The top left of the screen stays free for the hero's headline or picture. Hover: the link letters take the accent. On a phone: the panel spans the margins at 56px holding the wordmark and Menu; the action sits in the sheet.
signature: A single 580px opaque panel floats at the top right only, holding wordmark, links and action, and the whole top left of every screen stays free.
phone: Panel spans the margins at 56px: wordmark and Menu; the action in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: glass replaced by an opaque surface-tone panel; the action keeps the dealt button's one fill (no scene-tinted fill), so there is no colour sprawl. Un-banned.

name: Corner items with a centre segmented control
description: A fixed layer of five solid items inset by the page margin from the sides and 28px from the top and bottom, for a page with a film. Top left a 64px monogram tile (the first letter or the client's mark, in the ink with ground letter). Top centre a two-option segmented control 44px tall and about 220px wide in the surface tone, the current option filled in the ink: two one-word options that scroll to the page's two main sections, the current one following the section in view. Top right a Menu text button on a tab of the ground; Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page) with the links. Bottom left the one action as the dealt button; bottom right a 160x96 still of the film, opening it in a dialog. Hover: the segmented fill slides to the other option (240ms). On a phone: the monogram, the control and Menu in one 56px row at the top; the action and the film still in one row above the safe area.
signature: Five fixed items frame the screen: a 64px monogram tile top left, a two-option segmented control top centre, Menu top right, the action bottom left and a 160x96 film still bottom right that opens the film.
phone: Top row (monogram, control, Menu) at 56px; the action and the film still in a row above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the mascot is a typeset monogram (no drawn character); the control is a filled segmented control that scrolls to real sections (no switch that changes nothing); no sound toggle (the deal gives the page no audio); every item is solid, so nothing bare runs over content.

name: Corner wordmark shrinks, link block hides on scroll down
description: No bar fill. At the top-left margin a wordmark about 200px wide (h3 step) that, over the first 720px of scroll, scales down and crossfades into a 52px monogram tile (ink fill, ground letter), solid by the time content arrives. At the right a block 52px tall in the surface tone with the dealt corner holding four one-word links at 16px, which slides up out of view on scroll down (translateY -140%, 280ms) and returns on the first scroll up; beside it, at the right margin, the one action as the dealt button, which always stays. Everything that stays fixed stands on a solid fill, so nothing bare runs over content. Hover: the link letters roll. On a phone: the wordmark (shrinking to the tile) at the left and a Menu text button at the right; the action sits in the sheet's foot and as a button after the hero.
signature: Over the first 720px the top-left wordmark scales from about 200px wide into a 52px monogram tile, while a surface-tone block of four links at the right slides away on scroll down and returns on scroll up, and the action stays fixed.
phone: Wordmark shrinks to the tile at the left; Menu at the right; the action in the sheet foot and as a button after the hero.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mascot-style mark is a typeset monogram; the link block and the action are opaque; the fading lockup is a solid tile once content is under it.

name: Corner wordmark becomes a monogram, links fold into a Menu button
description: No bar: the wordmark at the top-left margin (h3 step) and four one-word links at the top right with the one action as the dealt button at the right margin. After 80px of scroll the wordmark swaps for a 48px monogram tile (ink fill, ground letter) by a crossfade with a 6px upward slide (240ms), and the four links collapse into one Menu button 48px tall in the surface tone beside the action. The action stays visible throughout. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page). Everything that stays fixed stands on a solid fill. Hover: the Menu button's fill swaps to the ink. On a phone: the monogram tile at the left, the Menu button and the action at the right from the start, at the page margin.
signature: At the top the wordmark and four links; after 80px of scroll the wordmark swaps for a 48px monogram tile and the four links fold into one Menu button beside the always-visible action.
phone: Monogram tile left, Menu button and the action right from the start, at the page margin.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mascot mark is replaced by a typeset monogram; the fixed tile and Menu button are solid; the action stays outside the trigger so it remains in reach.

name: Strip of four equal cells
description: A fixed strip 44px tall, full width, cut into four equal 360px cells at 1440. Cell one holds the wordmark (h4 step), cells two and three one-word links at 16px, cell four the one action in the accent with the dealt button's label. Each cell has its text 32px in from its left edge and is a flat fill from the page's own palette: cell one the surface tone, cell two the ground, cell three the surface tone, cell four the accent (never a new hue, no fourth fill). The strip is solid and fixed and does not change on scroll. Hover: the hovered cell's fill swaps to the ink and its letters to the ground (160ms). On a phone: the strip becomes a 56px bar with the wordmark and Menu; the sheet opens as four equal full-height blocks stacked in the same fills, each one a link or the action, filling the screen.
signature: A full-width 44px strip split into four equal cells of flat fills (surface, ground, surface, accent) with the text 32px in from each cell's left edge: wordmark, two links, the action.
phone: 56px bar with wordmark and Menu; the sheet is four equal full-height blocks.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: four different colours would be colour sprawl, so the cells use only the surface tone, the ground and the accent; cell one holds the wordmark so it is a real navigation; the strip is 44px tall so its 16px text is readable.

name: Floating box: mark, centred wordmark, Menu
description: A floating solid box 60px tall, inset by the page margin from the sides and 20px below the top edge, filled with the surface tone (so it reads as a box on the ground) and kept solid over video or pictures, with the dealt corner, no border and no shadow. A 36px monogram tile at the left, the wordmark dead centre (h4 step), the Menu text button at the right in the accent; no links in the bar. On scroll down the box slides 100px up out of view (280ms); on scroll up it returns. The links and the action live in the Menu's full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page). Hover on Menu: the text steps to the ink (160ms). On a phone: the same box at the page margin and 52px tall, wordmark at the left, Menu at the right.
signature: A solid surface-tone box 60px tall floats inset by the page margin and 20px below the top edge, holding a 36px monogram tile left, the wordmark dead centre and Menu right, with no links in it; it slides up on scroll down and back on scroll up.
phone: 52px box at the page margin: wordmark left, Menu right.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 1px light border is dropped (the surface-tone box reads against the ground and the picture without one); no shadow at rest. Over a full-bleed picture it reads as a header band, so keep it to one row. Un-banned.

name: Floating dark strip
description: A solid strip 64px tall in the ink (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), floating 12px below the top edge and inset by the page margin from the sides, the dealt corner, no border, no shadow. The wordmark at the left (h4 step, ground-coloured); four or five one-word links centred at 16px, 32px apart; the one action at the right as the dealt button turned to the ground colour with ink letters (on a dark page it keeps its accent fill). Fixed and identical when scrolling in both directions. Hover: the other links dim to 55% while one is hovered. On a phone: a 56px strip at the page margin from the sides with the wordmark and Menu; Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page).
signature: A solid dark strip 64px tall floats 12px below the top edge, inset by the page margin, with the wordmark left, four or five links centred and a ground-coloured action right, identical at every scroll position; hovering a link dims the others.
phone: 56px strip at the page margin: wordmark and Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Links capped at five; the strip is solid with no border and no shadow; over a photographic hero it reads as a header band, so keep it to one row; hover does not rely on the accent, which can equal the strip colour.

name: Four corner tabs
description: No bar: four small items fixed at the corners of the screen, each inset by the page margin from its side and 28px from its top or bottom edge. Top left the wordmark (h4 step) and top right a Menu text button (16px), each on a solid tab of the page ground (10-14px padding, the dealt corner); bottom left the one action as the dealt button (two or three words); bottom right a tab with the one word Top that fades in only after a screen of scroll. The items never change, and no hero or section content stands under a corner. Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page): the section names stacked at the h2 step on the left, the action and the email on the right. Hover: a tab's fill swaps from the ground to the ink and its letters the other way (180ms). On a phone the two top tabs stay at the page margin; the action sits 16px above the bottom edge plus the safe area; the bottom-right item is dropped.
signature: No bar anywhere: the wordmark tab top left, the Menu tab top right, the dealt action button bottom left and a Top tab bottom right (after one screen of scroll), all fixed in the four corners with nothing along the top edge.
phone: Top-left wordmark tab and top-right Menu tab at the page margin; the action bottom left above the safe area; bottom-right item dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Each corner item is solid (tabs of the ground, the dealt button), so no bare letters run over content; items are one to three words in sentence case at 16px, no tiny uppercase captions, no partner line.

name: Full-width bar, even link pitch
description: A full-width bar 60px tall, filled in the surface tone (one step from the ground) from the first pixel and fixed. A small monogram or wordmark at the left margin (h4 step); four one-word links at 16px whose centres sit on an even 250px pitch across the middle of the screen (x about 345, 595, 845 and 1095 at 1440), so no link is nearer another than 120px of air; at the right margin one text link and the one action as the dealt button, 40px tall. Ink is dark on a light surface tone (light on a dark page). Hover: the hovered link takes the accent while the others keep their ink, no underline. On a phone: a 56px bar with the wordmark left and a Menu text button and the action right.
signature: Four links whose centres sit on an even 250px pitch across the middle of a 60px surface-tone bar, at least 120px of air between neighbours, with the wordmark at the left and a text link plus the action at the right.
phone: 56px bar: wordmark left, Menu and the action right.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the translucent blurred bar is an opaque surface-tone bar; the idea, links on a wide even pitch, stays and only the see-through effect is lost on purpose. Un-banned.

name: Grid-aligned row of equal cells
description: A fixed row 60px tall on a solid band of the page ground, set on the page's own column grid: across the content width between the page margins, six equal cells with 20px gutters, each holding one item left-aligned at its column start, at body size (16px) in the text face, weight 500. Cell one holds the wordmark (the mark alone when the hero's headline is the name), cells two to five one-word links, cell six the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. There is no rule or line anywhere: the cells are the grid and the gutters separate them. The section in view takes the accent and weight 600; on hover the label shifts 6px right and takes the accent over 180ms. The sections below use the same six-column grid (their headings and text start on these column lines), so the row reads as their column head. On a phone: a 56px band with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the four links return as a 2 by 2 grid of large words inside the full-screen sheet.
signature: The bar's six items each start on the same column line as the content below them, with no rules, so the row reads as the column head of the whole page.
phone: 56px band: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links as a 2 by 2 grid of large words in the sheet.
avoidWith: pages whose sections do not share a column grid
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No rule under the cells: separation comes from the column grid and gutters, and hover moves and recolours the label (no underline, no outline, no dot). The row is on a solid band, so pictures never pass under bare letters. Type stays at body size, sentence case, text face; the action is the dealt button.

name: Grid-column text clusters
description: A fixed band 88px tall on the page ground carrying four clusters aligned to the 12-column grid at 1440. The wordmark (h4 step) at the left margin. From grid column 4: the section in view, one or two words at 16px in the muted ink, which changes with a 240ms roll as each section takes the screen. From grid column 10: a stack of three one-word links at 16px on a 26px line pitch. At the right margin: the one action as a plain text link at weight 600 in the accent. Fixed and unchanged otherwise. Hover: a link takes the accent (160ms). On a phone: the wordmark left and a Menu text button right; the section name and the links move into the sheet.
signature: Four clusters on the 12-column grid in an 88px band: wordmark at the left margin, the live section name at column 4, a stack of three links on a 26px pitch at column 10 and the action as a bare accent word at the right margin.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu text button right; the section name, the links and the action in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the 12px line pitch (tiny text) becomes 16px type on a 26px pitch; the toggle that switched nothing is the live section name; the fill-less layer is a solid band wherever content can pass under it.

name: Grid-placed chips, top and bottom
description: A fixed top strip of 40px chips on the 12-column grid, 24px below the top edge: the wordmark chip at column 1 (surface tone, h4 step), three one-word link chips from column 5 (surface tone, 16px, 12px apart), and the one action as the dealt button at column 11. A second fixed strip 24px above the viewport floor holds one wide chip about 280px across at columns 5 to 7 that names the section in view in one or two words and, after a screen of scroll, a Top chip at column 1. All chips are flat fills with 16px letters and the dealt corner. Hover: a chip's fill swaps to the ink and its letters to the ground (160ms). On a phone: the top row keeps the wordmark chip, a Menu chip and the action; the bottom strip keeps only the wide section chip.
signature: Chips placed on the 12-column grid: a wordmark chip at column 1, three link chips from column 5 and the action at column 11 along the top, and a wide section-name chip at columns 5 to 7 along the bottom edge.
phone: Top row: wordmark chip, Menu chip, the action; bottom: the section chip only.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the chips are 40px with 16px letters so no text is tiny; the monogram and icon chips are gone; one accent item only (the action); chips stay in the two strips so the page is not a page of boxes.

name: Large wordmark hands over to a corner mark
description: No bar: a large wordmark centred at the top of the hero, 320-480px wide at 1440 and never above the display step, 40px below the top edge, with no links beside it. Over the first 120px of scroll it rises 24px and fades out while a small copy of the wordmark (h4 step) fades in at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the page ground (12px padding, the dealt corner). The right side holds a Menu text button on a tab of the ground and the one action as the dealt button, at the right margin, fixed from the first pixel and never changing. The tabs stay fixed for the whole page, so nothing bare runs over content. Needs a hero whose headline is not the name. Hover: the tab fill swaps to the ink (180ms). On a phone: the large wordmark is 60% of the width and hands over to the small one the same way; Menu and the action stay at the right.
signature: The first screen opens with only a large centred wordmark (320-480px wide) and Menu plus the action at the right; after 120px of scroll the wordmark lifts away and a small wordmark tab stands at the top left.
phone: Large wordmark at 60% width hands over to a small tab at the left; Menu and the action tabs at the right.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No dot rail beside the menu (a rail or progress device); the fixed items stand on solid tabs; the large wordmark stays at the display step and is dealt only where the headline says something other than the name.

name: In-flow header hands over to a corner block
description: Two navigations in sequence. At load an in-flow header 88px tall sits inside the first screen and scrolls away with it: the wordmark at the left margin (h3 step), three or four one-word links at 16px starting at grid column 5, the one action as the dealt button, 44px tall, at the right margin. Once the hero has scrolled out (past 100svh minus 88px) a compact block 52px tall and about 120px wide, the dealt corner, in the ink with the word Menu in ground-coloured letters (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), fades in and drops 12px into place, fixed 20px from the top and the page margin from the right; the whole block opens a full-screen sheet on the ink (the surface tone on a dark page). The action follows as the dealt button beside it; the monogram may stay at the top left on a solid tab. Nothing hangs over content between the two states. On a phone the in-flow header is the wordmark and Menu; after the hero the same block appears at the top right.
signature: Nothing is fixed on the first screen: an 88px in-flow header scrolls away with the hero, and only after that a 52px ink block with the word Menu drops in at the top right with the action beside it.
phone: In-flow wordmark and Menu; after the hero the Menu block and the action appear top right.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The block is opaque with a text label (no icon-only trigger); the in-flow bar scrolls away so no fixed transparent layer runs over content.

name: Large centred wordmark that shrinks into a band
description: No bar at first: a large wordmark centred at the top of the first screen, about 400px wide at 1440 for a ten-letter name and never above the display step, the name on one line. Two one-word links stand at the left margin; at the right margin one one-word link and the one action as the dealt button, vertically centred on the wordmark; all at 16px. Over the first 240px of scroll the wordmark scales to about 30% (120px wide, transform with its origin at top centre) while the side items stay where they are, and the row settles into a 64px solid band of the page ground, fixed from then on. The ink is one strong colour chosen to read on the hero and on the band. Needs a short name (up to about ten letters) that still holds at 120px. On a phone: the wordmark centred at 200px with Menu at the left and the action at the right, settling to a 56px band the same way.
signature: The first screen opens with a large centred wordmark (about 400px wide) between two link groups, and within 240px of scroll it scales down to about 120px as the row settles into a 64px solid band.
phone: Wordmark centred at 200px, Menu left, action right; settles into a 56px band on scroll.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with a condition. A large wordmark in the bar is not the banned giant name (it stays at the display step and shrinks), but it is dealt only where the hero headline is not the name; the blend-difference ink is replaced by one flat ink and the settled band is opaque.

name: Left rail of stacked tiles
description: A fixed rail 120px wide inset 20px from the left edge and from the top, holding a stack of six solid tiles with 8px between them: a wordmark tile (the name on two lines at the h4 step) at the top, four link tiles 96px tall each with a one-word link at 16px, and one action tile 120px tall in the accent. The five other tiles are in the surface tone with ink letters; only the ground, the surface tone, the ink and the accent appear. At desktop widths the page wrapper takes the rail's width plus 24px on both sides in place of the dealt page margin (about 146px each at 1440), so the margins stay equal and the rail sits in the left margin. Hover: a link tile's fill swaps to the ink and its letters to the ground (180ms). On a phone: the rail becomes a 56px top bar with the wordmark, the action and a Menu text button; the tiles stack in the sheet.
signature: A 120px-wide rail of six solid tiles (wordmark, four links, the action in the accent) stands fixed in the left margin, and the whole page is centred in the width that remains, with equal margins on both sides.
phone: 56px top bar with wordmark, the action and Menu; tiles stack in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Two fills only (the surface tone and the accent); the rail is inset from the edge and the content keeps equal margins on both sides; the Contact tile is gone because the action already says it.

name: Links first, logo and actions arrive
description: A bar 88px tall that is almost empty at rest. At the top of the page only four one-word links stand in the centre, at body size (16px), weight 500, 48px apart, in one ink chosen to read on the hero: no wordmark, no button, no fill (the hero's headline is the name). The first frame is exactly this. After the first 80 to 120px of scroll the bar completes itself and settles to 64px on a solid band of the page ground, fixed: a 36px monogram chip (ink fill, ground-coloured letter, the dealt corner) appears at the left margin and, at the right margin, the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall, each fading in and moving 8px over 240ms, 60ms apart; a two-letter language switch in plain text goes before the action only if the page really has two languages. The links stay centred in the page ink. Accent: the action and link hover. On a phone: a 56px solid band from the start, the monogram at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the four links wait in the full-screen sheet.
signature: At the top the 88px bar holds only four centred one-word links (no wordmark, no button, no fill); after 80 to 120px of scroll a monogram chip and the action arrive and it settles to a 64px solid band.
phone: 56px band from the start: monogram left, Menu text button and the action right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: heroes whose headline is not the name
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The first frame is the finished bar (nothing arrives on load); the bar takes a solid band of the ground as soon as it stays fixed over content, so no bare letters run over content; links are one word at body size, no numbers; the action is the dealt button, not a second shape; the language switch is plain text and only for a page with two languages; the monogram is type on a chip.

name: Live section name in the centre slot
description: A fixed solid band 56px tall in the page ground. The wordmark at the left margin (h4 step); at the right margin a Menu text button beside the one action (the dealt button, 40px tall); dead centre the live section name: one or two words at 16px in mixed case, in the ink and the same words as that section's heading or nav link, never a sentence. When a new section takes the screen the old name slides up out of a 24px mask while the new one slides up in (280ms, ease-out), so the centre reads as a quiet marker of where you are, without numbers. Over the hero the band has no fill and the centre slot is empty; the band fills solid after the hero. Hover: the Menu text takes the accent (160ms). Needs four or more named sections. On a phone the live name is dropped: wordmark left, Menu and the action right in a 56px band.
signature: The centre of a 56px band shows the name of the section in view (one or two words at 16px) and swaps it by sliding the old name up out of a 24px mask as each new section takes the screen.
phone: 56px band: wordmark left, Menu and the action right; the live name is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the one-line serif caption (a sentence in the bar) is now the one- or two-word name of the section in view, no numbers; the white band is a solid band of the page ground. Un-banned.

name: Text row with status words
description: A slim three-part text row on a solid 60px band of the page ground, fixed at the top, on the page margins. Everything is set at body size (16px) in the text face, weight 500, sentence case, no letter-spacing. Left: the wordmark (display face, same size, heaviest dealt weight) and 24px after it a status of one to three words (a place, or a state such as open this week). Centre: a second status of one to three words, centred on the page. Right: four one-word links 28px apart and after them the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. The link of the section in view takes the accent and weight 600; hover shifts a link to the accent over 160ms. The band is the page ground at every scroll position, so over a hero of the same ground it is invisible and over a picture it is a slim header strip; content never runs under bare letters. On a phone: a 56px band with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the sheet opens on the page ground with the links stacked at the sub step in the display face and the two statuses beneath.
signature: A 60px text-only band with a status of one to three words beside the wordmark and a second status centred on the page, so the bar reads as a printed masthead line rather than logo-and-links.
phone: 56px band: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links and statuses in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: heroes with a text row of their own at the top edge
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The row sits on a solid band, so nothing bare runs over pictures; all type is body size or more, sentence case, in the text face (no monospace, no tiny tracked uppercase); each status is one to three words, never a sentence; links capped at four plus the action; the current link is marked by colour and weight, no dot or drawn shape; the action is the dealt button.

name: Name-roll bar with live clock
description: A bar 88px tall that belongs to the first screen and scrolls away with it. Left: a short form of the name in the display face at the lead step; on the first 40px of scroll it rolls up 12px inside a masked line and the full name takes its place, widening from about 110px to about 190px. Centre: a monogram of one or two letters in the display face at the sub step and two one-word links 32px apart at body size (16px), weight 500. Right: the studio's local time (hours and minutes, updated each minute) beside a place word, at body size in tabular figures of the text face, then Menu as the dealt button in the ink, which opens a full-screen sheet. Over the hero the bar has no fill and one ink chosen for the hero. Once the hero has gone the name stays fixed at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the ground and Menu at the top-right margin with the one action beside it as the dealt button in the accent, so the way back stays in reach. On a phone: the short name at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the monogram, links and clock move into the sheet.
signature: The name at the left rolls from a short form to the full name inside a masked line on the first 40px of scroll, and the studio's local time and place word sit beside a Menu button at the right.
phone: Short name left, Menu and the action right; monogram, links and clock in the full-screen sheet; the name and the buttons stay fixed on solid tabs after the hero.
avoidWith: bars that already carry a live readout
heroes with a second wordmark at the top
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The clock is a plain time readout, not a counter, in tabular figures of the text face (never monospace); Menu and the action are the dealt button, not outlined controls or a second shape; the name roll is plain type on scroll and nothing arrives on load; the italic mark is dropped (one face); after the hero only solid tabs and filled buttons stay fixed.

name: Pill controls shrinking to icon circles
description: A fixed control layer with no bar, for a hero whose headline is the name. At the top of the first screen three filled buttons in the dealt button's shape, 48px tall, labels at body size, weight 600: the one action in the accent at the left margin, one secondary word that goes to a real section (Visit, Listen) in the surface tone at the centre, and Menu in the ink at the right margin; the space between them stays empty. After the first 100px of scroll the action and the secondary button shrink over 300ms into 44px square buttons holding an arrow glyph and fade out upward; the wordmark comes in at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the ground, Menu stays, and a bottom row fades in 20px above the bottom edge on the same margins: the action as the dealt button at the left and, only if the page has audio, a Sound button in the surface tone at the right. Every fixed item is a solid fill, never bare letters, and the page keeps 96px free under its last line. On a phone: Menu at the top right and the bottom row holding the action alone from the start; the wordmark tab comes in at the top left after the first scroll.
signature: No bar: three separate filled buttons float at the top (action left, one secondary word centre, Menu right) with empty space between them, and after 100px of scroll the two left ones shrink to 44px arrow buttons and leave while a bottom row takes the action.
phone: Menu top right; the bottom row holds the action from the start; the wordmark tab comes in top left after the first scroll.
avoidWith: pages with a cookie or chat widget at the bottom edge
heroes whose headline is not the name
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The tagline between the buttons and the key hint are gone, so the centre stays empty and nothing reads as a sentence; every button is the dealt button (no second shape); the arrow is a standard glyph, no emoji and no play glyph since no film is dealt; every fixed item is a solid fill, never bare text over content; the one action stands once per screen (top on the first screen, bottom after it).

name: Right rail with rotated labels
description: A fixed rail 64px wide running the full height of the right edge, never changing, filled with the surface tone. From the top: a 64px square Menu tile (ink fill, the word Menu at body size in ground-coloured letters, the dealt button's corner), the wordmark turned 90 degrees in the display face at the lead step, three one- or two-word links turned 90 degrees at body size (16px), weight 500, sentence case, a two-letter language toggle turned the same way (only on a page with two languages), and at the bottom a 64 by 120px action tile: the dealt button turned 90 degrees in the accent, its two-word label running along it. The tiles are told apart by fill steps (the surface tone, the ink, the accent), never by rules. The content's right margin is measured from the rail's inner edge and equals the left margin, and full-bleed sections stop at the rail, so nothing runs under it. Hover: a link's letters take the accent over 160ms. On a phone: the rail becomes a 56px top bar with the Menu tile at the left, the wordmark, and the action tile at the right, all horizontal; the language toggle moves into the sheet.
signature: A solid 64px rail is fixed down the whole right edge with the wordmark and links turned 90 degrees, an ink Menu tile at the top and an accent action tile at the foot; content and full-bleed sections stop at its inner edge.
phone: 56px top bar: Menu tile, wordmark, action tile, all horizontal; the language toggle in the sheet.
avoidWith: any second fixed bar or side rail
heroes that run edge to edge under the right side
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tiles are separated by fills and the turned text stays at body size, sentence case (no tiny tracked uppercase); the rail is one tone with two fills, not a stack of outlined boxes; the Menu and action tiles follow the dealt button's corner and label style; content keeps equal margins measured from the rail.

name: Scene-coloured solid bar, hides
description: A fixed solid bar 56px tall: the wordmark at the left margin (display face, lead step); at the right one one-word link at body size (16px), weight 500, a Sound word only if the page has audio, and the one action as the dealt button, 44px tall, in the opposite tone of the bar (the ink on a ground or surface bar, the ground on an ink bar). The bar's fill changes with each section, easing over 320ms, through the page's ground, surface tone and ink only (never the accent, never a hue of its own), and the letters flip to whichever of the ink or the ground reads best. On scroll down the bar slides off the top (translateY -100%, 500ms ease-out); on any scroll up it returns over 400ms in the tone of the section in view. On a phone: a 56px bar with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the link waits in the full-screen sheet.
signature: A solid 56px bar that changes its fill to the tone of whichever section is under it (ground, surface or ink, 320ms) with letters flipping to stay readable, and that slides away on scroll down.
phone: 56px bar in the section's tone: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; hides and returns the same way.
avoidWith: pages with one ground colour throughout
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No colour sprawl: the bar only takes the page's ground, surface tone and ink (the accent never fills it); the sound toggle is a word, not an emoji or drawn icon; the action is the dealt button.

name: Scroll-assembled full-screen tile mosaic
description: The first screen carries only the wordmark at the top-left margin and a Menu text button at the top-right margin, each on a solid tab of the ground; both stay fixed after the hero. Dealt only for a page with at least five real sections. Past the hero, nine loose flat tiles drift in from scattered offsets (up to 200px away, up to 4 degrees of tilt), scrubbed by the scroll over about 120vh (not a timed entrance), and lock into a pinned full-screen 3 by 3 mosaic with 8px gaps inside the page margins (each tile about 448 by 280 at 1440 by 900): one tile holds the wordmark, one the one action in the accent, and the other seven link to the page's sections, with Contact (the word, never the address) filling any left over. Tiles are flat fills of the surface tone on the ground, the action tile in the accent, nothing else; each label sits bottom-left, 24px in, in the display face at the sub step, sentence case. Hover: the tile's fill steps to the accent with accent-ink letters and its label shifts 8px right. After assembling, the mosaic releases and is the page's index scene; from then on the Menu tab reopens the same mosaic as a full-screen sheet. Reduced motion shows it assembled. On a phone: two columns by five rows inside the page margins, the wordmark tile spanning both columns of the top row, each row one fifth of the screen height; the tiles fade in without drift.
signature: Past the hero, nine flat tiles drift in with the scroll and lock into a pinned full-screen 3 by 3 index (wordmark, the accent action tile and seven section tiles) that the Menu tab reopens as a sheet.
phone: First screen: wordmark and Menu tabs. The mosaic is two columns by five rows inside the page margins, the wordmark tile spanning the top row; tiles fade in without drift.
avoidWith: tile or card grids in the sections right after it
houseRuleCheck: Clean with care. A mosaic is a set of boxes, so it stays this one scene and the sections around it stay open and varied (no page only of boxes, no tile grids right after it); tiles are flat fills with words only: no outlines, no icons, no boxes on photographs, no tile in a tile; only the surface tone and the accent as fills (no wall of tiles in several fills); labels at the sub step and never the email at display size; the first screen keeps a real wordmark and Menu; the pin is about 120vh.

name: Segmented cell row returns as full bar
description: At the top, a centred floating row 20px below the top edge: cells 48px tall, each filled with the surface tone with the dealt corner and separated by 4px gaps through which the page shows. In order: a wordmark cell (120px wide), four link cells (about 120px each, one-word labels centred at body size, weight 500) and an action cell (140px) as the dealt button in the accent. Right of the row, only if the page has a moving picture or sound, sits a 48px solid Pause button in the ink with the dealt corner. On scroll down the whole row slides up out of view (translateY -140%, 400ms). On any scroll up a different object returns: a full-width bar 64px tall with the wordmark at the left margin, the four links centred and the action at the right margin, no shadow, filled with whichever of the ground and the surface tone the section underneath is not on, so its edge always reads. On a phone: a centred row of three cells (wordmark, Menu, action) 12px below the top edge, returning the same way as a full-width 56px bar.
signature: A floating row of separate surface-tone cells 4px apart (wordmark, four links, accent action) slides away on scroll down and returns on scroll up as a different object, a full-width 64px bar.
phone: Centred row of three cells (wordmark, Menu, action); it hides on scroll down and returns as a full-width 56px bar.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The returning bar separates by taking the other of the ground and the surface tone, not by a shadow or a line; the seams are gaps between filled cells, not rules or outlines; every cell has the dealt corner; links capped at four plus the action, which is the dealt button.

name: Row of separate filled chips
description: No bar fill. A fixed row of individually filled chips in the ink, 48px tall, 8px apart, running from the left page margin: first a square chip holding the monogram, then four link chips (padding 0 20px, the dealt corner, one-word labels at body size, weight 500, in the ground colour), and one chip alone at the right margin carrying the one action as the dealt button in the accent. The page shows through the gaps between chips, so the row reads as loose pieces over whatever scene is below; every letter stands on a chip, never on the page. The chip of the section in view takes the surface tone with ink letters; hover moves a chip's fill to the accent with accent-ink letters over 160ms. On a phone: the monogram chip at the left and a Menu chip and the action chip at the right, 44px tall; the links wait in the full-screen sheet.
signature: No bar: a fixed row of separate solid ink chips 8px apart (monogram, four links, and the action chip alone at the right margin) with the page showing through the gaps.
phone: Monogram chip left, Menu chip and the action chip right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: pages that are mostly boxes elsewhere
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Chips are navigation, not content cards, but a row of chips over boxed sections can tip a page toward all boxes, so the sections beneath stay open. Solid fills only (the ink, the surface tone for the current chip, the accent for the action), no outline, no blur, no shadow; links capped at four plus the action, which is the dealt button; type at body size.

name: Solid left-cluster bar, hides, returns with action
description: A fixed bar 80px tall on a solid band of the page ground, on the page margins. Left: a lockup (a 32px monogram of the name's first letter and the wordmark in the display face at the lead step), then 40px later four one-word links at body size (16px), weight 500, 32px apart. Right: at rest the one action as a quiet text link at weight 600. On scroll down beyond 8px the bar slides fully out (translateY -100%, 360ms ease-out). On any scroll up it returns over the same time at 64px with the action grown from the text link into the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. Ink: the page ink. Accent: the returning button only. On a phone: a 64px bar with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button at the right, the same hide and return, the action button appearing beside Menu on return.
signature: A left-weighted bar (lockup then four links) hides on scroll down and returns shorter, 64px, with the action grown from a quiet text link into the dealt button.
phone: 64px bar: wordmark left, Menu text button right; hides on scroll down and returns with the action button beside Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Solid fill, no rule, no shadow; 80px at rest, under a tenth of the first screen; the returning action is the dealt button, so no second button shape and no split arrow part.

name: Minimal solid bar with control swap
description: A fixed bar 72px tall on a solid band of the page ground holding only three things: the lockup at the left margin (a 28px monogram plus the wordmark), and at the right margin a Menu text button with one quiet slot before it: the language as a text dropdown (the current language at body size with a standard caret glyph) on a page with two languages, otherwise a Sign in or Visit text link that really goes somewhere. Once the hero has scrolled away (past the hero height minus 72px) that slot swaps in place for the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall, cross-fading over 150ms; at the same moment the bar's fill steps to the surface tone so it separates from the sections below without a line. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet on the ink (on a dark page the surface tone) with the action and the email. On a phone: the lockup and Menu from the start; the action button appears beside Menu after the hero.
signature: The bar holds only a lockup and Menu; its one quiet slot (language or Visit) swaps in place for the action button after the hero while the bar steps to the surface tone.
phone: Lockup and Menu text button; the action button appears beside Menu right after the hero.
avoidWith: bars with a full link set
pages with no distinct hero to scroll past
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A line under the bar is replaced by a step to the surface tone; the action is the dealt button, never outlined; the language dropdown is plain text with a standard caret; Menu is a text button and its sheet keeps the links, the action and the email in reach.

name: Solid sticky bar, left cluster plus utilities
description: A sticky bar 72px tall that never hides, the same scrolling up or down. Left: the lockup, then three primary links at body size (16px), weight 500, 28px apart. Right: a search glyph (only if the site has search), up to two utility links (Sign in, Help; only ones that exist) at body size, weight 400, in the muted ink, and the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. Two weights and two inks give a primary and a secondary level without any divider. The bar separates from the content by a fill step, never a rule or a shadow: it takes whichever of the ground and the surface tone the section underneath is not on, changing over 200ms as sections pass. On a phone: the lockup at the left and the action and a Menu text button at the right; search and the utility links move into the sheet.
signature: A never-hiding 72px bar with two levels of links, three primary links beside the lockup and two lighter utility links beside the action, told apart by weight and tone alone, its fill swapping between the ground and the surface tone.
phone: Lockup left, the action and a Menu text button right; search and the utility links in the sheet.
avoidWith: announcement or utility strips above it
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Separation is a fill step that follows the section under the bar (the other of the ground and the surface tone), so it holds on every section; no rule, no shadow; links capped at three primary and two utility; utility text is 16px or more; the action is the dealt button.

name: Solid bar with flush action block, hides
description: A sticky bar 72px tall on a solid band of the page ground. Left: the lockup at the page margin. Centre: five one-word links at body size (16px), weight 500, 28px apart. Right, flush to the screen edge and running the full height of the bar: a cell 88px wide in the surface tone holding a two-letter language label on a page with two languages, or Sign in if the product has accounts (otherwise the cell is left out), then a 216px action block filled in the accent as the dealt button is, with a body-size weight 600 label, square corners. No rule anywhere: the cells are separated by their fills. The bar slides out on scroll down (translateY -100%, 360ms) and returns on any scroll up. On a phone: the lockup at the left, a Menu text button, and a 120px action block flush to the right edge, with the same hide and return.
signature: The right end of the bar is two full-height cells flush to the screen edge, a surface-tone cell and a 216px accent action block with square corners and no gap, while the lockup and links keep the page margin.
phone: Lockup left, Menu text button, then a 120px action block flush to the right edge; same hide and return.
avoidWith: a second fixed element at the right edge
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Rules under the bar and beside the language cell are replaced by fills; the cells are filled blocks, not outlined boxes; the action block is the dealt button's fill and label style at full bar height; it meets the screen edge as part of a full-width bar, not as content running into the edge.

name: Split bar, centred wordmark, flat ground
description: A symmetrical split bar 80px tall. The wordmark sits dead centre at the h3 step with 96px of clear air on each side; two or three one-word links at 16px stand at the left margin, one link and the one action (the dealt button, 44px tall) at the right margin, 36px between items, each group ending 96px from the wordmark. The bar is filled with the page ground from the first pixel and its letters are in the ink, so over a flat-ground hero it reads as part of the page and over a picture it is a solid header band with the picture starting below it; either way no content runs under it. It stays fixed and never changes height or colour. Hover: the letters lift 3px and take the accent (160ms). On a phone: a 60px bar with the wordmark centred, Menu at the left and the action at the right; the links wait in the full-screen sheet.
signature: The wordmark sits dead centre of a solid 80px bar with 96px of clear air on each side, two or three links on its left and one link plus the action on its right; the bar never changes.
phone: 60px bar: wordmark centred, Menu left, the action right; links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The bar is opaque from the first pixel, so content never runs under bare letters; links are one word; the wordmark is not repeated when the hero headline is the name (the mark alone then).

name: Split bar takes each scene's ground
description: A fixed bar 60px tall in three parts: three one-word links at the left margin (body size, weight 500, 24px apart), a 32px monogram centred, and at the right margin one text link and the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall; on a shop a basket glyph button joins them. Over the hero the bar has no fill; as the following sections arrive it fills with each section's tone over 320ms and the monogram and links flip to the ink or ground that reads on it; the tones come from the page's ground, surface tone and ink only, never the accent, never a new hue. A second element persists: a fixed bottom row 20px above the bottom edge on the page margins with small solid tabs in the ink holding body-size words: Top, and Sound only if the page has audio. On a phone: the monogram centred, a Menu text button at the left and the action at the right; the bottom row keeps Top.
signature: A fixed 60px split bar (three links left, monogram centred, action right) that takes the tone of each section under it, plus a small solid Top tab fixed at the bottom edge.
phone: Monogram centred, Menu text button left, the action button right; the bottom row keeps Top.
avoidWith: other fixed bottom rows or docks
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Section tones come from the page palette only (no colour sprawl, the accent never fills the bar); the bottom controls are words at body size on solid ink tabs, not a progress bar or counter and not bare letters over content; links capped at four plus the action, which is the dealt button.

name: Pair of floating panels
description: Two panels float 17px below the top edge, together spanning the page margins. A wide panel (about 1010px at 1440), 56px tall, in the surface tone with the dealt corner: the lockup at its left, five one-word links centred at body size, weight 500. A narrow panel about 190px by 56px beside it is the one action, the dealt button stretched to that size in the accent, with a weight 600 label. They sit 19px apart; on a shop or a site with search a 56px square glyph button (bag or search) in the ink with the dealt corner stands centred in a wider gap between them. Both stay fixed and opaque at every scroll position; where the section underneath is also on the surface tone the wide panel flips to the ink with ground-coloured letters (200ms). On a phone: one panel the width less the page margins, 52px tall, holding the lockup, a Menu text button and a small action button.
signature: Two separate opaque panels float 17px below the top edge, a wide one holding lockup and links and a narrow 190px accent action panel 19px beside it, instead of one bar.
phone: One panel the width less the page margins: lockup, Menu text button, small action button.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The panels are navigation, not cards, opaque with no shadow at rest and no outline; the corner is the dealt corner and the action is the dealt button; the glyph button appears only where the site has search or a basket.

name: Logo split across the width
description: No bar. The wordmark is cut into three pieces set at one height, 28px from the top of the first screen: the first at the left margin, the second centred on the page, the third ending at the right margin. Each piece is a syllable or short word of three to five letters in the display face at the sub step, in the dealt display weight, so the three read together left to right as the name. Beneath the right piece, right-aligned, a row of three one-word links at body size (16px), weight 500, 20px apart, and after them the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. The pieces and links belong to the first screen and scroll away with it; their ink is chosen to read on the hero. After the hero a 56px solid band of the ground returns on any scroll up with the whole wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right. Dealt only where the hero's headline is not the name and the name splits cleanly into three short pieces. On a phone: one 56px row with the whole wordmark at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the split is a desktop device.
signature: The wordmark is cut into three pieces set at one height across the top of the first screen (left margin, centre, right margin) with the links tucked under the last piece, and there is no bar until the first scroll up.
phone: One 56px row: the whole wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the split stays on desktop.
avoidWith: heroes that set the name again in giant type
names that do not break into three short pieces
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Type only, no drawn shapes; the name is cut by letters, never by an illustration, and no piece is larger than the sub step (no giant name); the pieces scroll away with the hero so no bare letters run over content, and a solid band brings the navigation back; the action is the dealt button.

name: Bar with centre toggle on a flooding ground
description: A fixed bar 88px tall on a page whose ground is one fixed layer that floods to the tone of the section in view over 400ms; the bar is filled with that same ground and changes with it, so it is opaque yet reads as part of the page. Left: the wordmark in the display face at the sub step. Centre: a two-option text toggle, a 240px by 52px track in a tone that differs from the bar's fill (chosen from the ground, the surface tone and the ink) with a sliding filled indicator under the active word (ink fill, ground-coloured letters, body size, weight 500, the dealt corner, 240ms slide); the two words switch the page between two audiences, collections or modes that the page really has, so the toggle changes content. Right: a Menu text button and the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. The tones come from the page's ground, surface tone and ink only (never the accent, never a new hue) and the letters flip to the contrast tone with each. On a phone: a 64px bar with the wordmark at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the toggle moves to the top of the full-screen sheet.
signature: A two-option toggle sits in the centre of an 88px bar whose fill floods to the tone of each section in view, with the wordmark at the left and Menu plus the action at the right.
phone: 64px bar: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the toggle at the top of the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The bar is 88px (navigation takes a tenth of the first screen at most) and filled with the flooding tone, so content never runs under bare letters; the tones are the page's ground, surface and ink only; the toggle track is a filled tone, not an outline, and the toggle changes real content (never a switch that changes nothing); the action is the dealt button.

name: Tall spread header that scrolls away
description: A tall header, 96px, that belongs to the first screen and scrolls away with it (absolutely positioned over the hero, not fixed), on the page margins. Left: a wordmark about 200px wide (display face at the head step in the heaviest dealt weight) followed 40px later by one one-word link; centre: two one-word links 32px apart; right: the one action as a text link at weight 600 in the accent at the right margin; all links at body size (16px), weight 500, so the three slots spread across the whole width. Over the hero its ink is one colour chosen for the hero. On a page of up to six screens nothing replaces it; on a longer page the one action returns after the hero as the dealt button in the accent fixed at the top-right margin, so the way to act stays in reach. Dealt only where the hero's headline is not the name. On a phone: a 64px row with the wordmark (about 140px) at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
signature: A 96px header across the full width on the first screen only: a head-size wordmark at the left with a link after it, two links in the centre and the action as an accent text link at the right, all scrolling away with the hero.
phone: 64px row: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Height cut from 120px to 96px so the header stays small furniture; the big wordmark is the header's, never a giant footer name, and the hero below still fills the first screen alone; on a long page the action stays in reach as the dealt button.

name: Tall wordmark bar that collapses
description: A fixed bar that starts tall and collapses on scroll. At rest it is 96px high with no fill over the hero: a typographic wordmark at the left (about 212px wide, the display face at the head step in the heaviest dealt weight, type only, never drawn), four one-word links at body size (16px), weight 600, 32px apart, and at the right margin the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall (on a shop the basket as a word before it). Over the first 120px of scroll the bar eases to 64px and takes a solid band of the page ground; the wordmark scales and cross-fades (200ms) into a 40px monogram chip, and the four links fold into Menu as the dealt button in the ink beside the action, so content never runs under bare letters. Where the hero's headline is the name, the first screen shows the monogram chip alone. On a phone: a 72px bar with the wordmark about 150px wide, a Menu text button and the action, collapsing to 56px with the monogram the same way.
signature: On the first screen the 96px bar carries a head-size type wordmark and four links; over 120px of scroll it collapses to a 64px solid band where the wordmark has become a 40px monogram chip and the links have folded into Menu.

name: Text-only three-part row
description: A pure-text row 56px tall with no buttons, chips or icons. The wordmark at grid column 1 (h4 step); a run of three or four one-word links starting at grid column 7 (about the middle of the page) at 16px with 32px between them; the one action as a plain text link at the right margin in the accent at weight 600. The row sits on a solid band of the page ground and is fixed; over a hero of the same ground the band is invisible, over any other it is a plain header band. The link of the section in view takes weight 600 (never an underline); each link reserves its weight-600 width so nothing shifts. Content scrolls under the band, never under bare letters. Hover: the link ink steps to the accent (160ms). On a phone: the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button at the right; the links wait in the full-screen sheet with the action at the foot.
signature: Nothing but type in a 56px row: wordmark at column 1, links from column 7, the action as a bare accent word at the right margin, with no button, chip or underline anywhere and the section in view marked by weight 600 alone.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu text button right; links and action in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The row sits on a solid band, so content never slides under bare letters; the current link is marked by weight, not an underline (no thin rules); the hero carries the dealt button, so the bar's text-link action never doubles it.

name: Menu, centred mark, scene word column
description: A loose fixed layer for a page whose scenes hold the screen one at a time (full-screen or pinned scenes). Top left: a Menu text button (body size, weight 600, switching to Close) that opens a full-screen sheet. Top centre: the monogram in type as a 40px mark. Top right: the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. At the right margin, vertically centred: a column of five to eight scene names in the text face at body size on a 44px line pitch, right-aligned, sentence case; the current scene in full ink, the others in the muted ink; hover brings a name to full ink over 160ms and a click goes to that scene. Every item stands on a small solid tab of the ground (8-12px padding, the dealt corner), so no letters run over moving pictures. On a phone: Menu, the monogram and the action stay at the top; the column is replaced by two text links (Previous, Next) with typeset arrows, 44px targets, at the bottom centre.
signature: No bar: Menu top left, a centred monogram, the action top right, and a right-aligned column of five to eight scene names at the right margin (current in full ink, the rest muted) that jumps between scenes.
phone: Menu, the monogram and the action at the top; two text links (Previous, Next) with typeset arrows, 44px targets, at the bottom centre replace the column.
avoidWith: other scroll indicators or progress devices
pages with fewer than four distinct scenes

name: Transparent bar, centre monogram, scale settle
description: A fixed bar that settles from 84px to 64px over the first 720px of scroll. Left: the lockup (the wordmark in the display face with a small mark). Centre: a monogram of one or two letters in the display face at the head step. Right: a Menu text button at body size, weight 600, and the one action as the dealt button in the accent, 44px tall. The lockup and the button start at scale 1.2 and ease to 1 across those 720px, scroll-linked, with transform origins at the left and right edges. Over the hero the bar has no fill and its ink is chosen to read on it; by the time the hero has gone it has taken a solid band of the page ground with ink letters, and it stays fixed so. Where the hero's headline is the name, the lockup shows its mark alone. On a phone: a 60px band with the lockup at scale 1 at the left, the monogram centred at 36px and Menu at the right; the action sits in the hero and at the sheet's foot.

name: Open bar, wordmark left, links right
description: A two-slot bar 88px tall on the page margins. The wordmark stands at the left margin at the h3 step; at the right margin one to three one-word links at 16px, 36px apart, the last of them the one action as the dealt button, 44px tall. The whole middle stays empty. Over the hero the bar has no fill and sits on the hero's own flat ground (or the calm top of its picture, one tone behind the letters), its ink chosen to read on it. Once the hero has gone (scroll past 100svh minus 88px) it settles into a 60px solid band of the page ground (260ms, transform and background-colour only), the ink following the ground, and stays fixed. name: Transparent bar, phone bottom dock

No blur, no shadow at rest; the page keeps 96px free under its last line.

name: Transparent bar with pill-link group
